title: ursinia ciliaris
intro: Ursinia ciliaris, commonly known as the Yellow Cape Daisy, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) native to the Western Cape Province in South Africa. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ursinia ciliaris include its potential use as an antimicrobial agent, which may aid in the treatment of bacterial infections, as well as its possible use as a diuretic, which may help in the management of fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of Ursinia ciliaris include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
